description:
Ask before you call. No key needed. Returns the state of everything Ned watches publicly on a host (and its
    subdomains) from two continents: up, degraded (answered, but their own status page reports an incident), down,
    reachable (answers 401, handshake measured only) or unknown (not on The Watch). Also since when, the last change seen
    (tool list, version, auth) and how soon to ask again. Try api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, mcp.context7.com,
    status.github.com. If unknown, the answer says how to add it (first five watches free).
name: is_up
